reasoning_summary: The selected features cover broad semantic groups relevant to credit risk including repayment behavior, indebtedness, leverage, exposure, utilization, capacity, delinquency, and customer history. Priority was given to features with zero missingness and stable, interpretable credit-risk meaning. Redundancy was controlled by selecting representative aggregates from similar groups (e.g., fico_mean over fico_range_low/high, loan_to_income over loan_amnt variants). Features with potential leakage or unstable sparse tail distributions were avoided. The list balances stable, durable signals with broad coverage to support downstream statistical selection and redundancy pruning.
